stop_condition:
Report HIGH only for: a forgeable, over-broad, or non-deliberate route to a quarantine
override; a path by which a malformed or wrong record is selected as governing; a regression
of refuse-on-ambiguity; an unreachable recovery for an operator who hits the deadlock;
untrusted text reaching a shell or awk interpolation; or a legitimate task deadlocked.
MEDIUM/LOW otherwise. If there is no HIGH, say so plainly rather than manufacturing one.

findings.evidence: The selector converts the unbounded digit string with `iters[n] = itraw + 0` before computing and comparing maxima. On this host, awk reports `9007199254740992` and `9007199254740993` as equal. Thus an older record with iteration=9007199254740993 and a newer record with iteration=9007199254740992 are treated as sharing the maximum iteration.
findings.description: The lower-iteration timestamp winner is then considered simultaneously maximal on both axes and selected as governing, instead of producing review_artifact_selection_disagreement. This is a wrong-record selection and a regression of refuse-on-ambiguity. Compare iteration strings exactly by length and lexicographic order, or impose and validate a safely representable upper bound before numeric conversion.
